structured.answer: I'd lean towards Harel's "כספי (שקלי)" track: it shows 0% shares and 0% foreign currency, Harel is a big name I know, and it shows about 4.25% a year over 3 years. But I won't sign anything until I ask my son or the bank.

Too many numbers per line on a black background; I lost my place in the middle of the lines and had to guess which number belonged to which heading
